chains.name: CORS Null-Origin Session Steal
chains.wave_5_action: EXECUTE — no further validation needed. Dispatch auth-exploit immediately.

steps.description: Craft PoC HTML page served from null origin (sandboxed iframe or data: URI)
steps.method: fetch with credentials: include from null-origin iframe
steps.expected: CORS response includes ACAO: null + ACAC: true, response body readable cross-origin

steps.description: Read session token / user object from /auth/me response in JavaScript
steps.expected: JWT or session token extracted and available to attacker JS
Token received server-side; victim session fully hijacked

supporting_findings.note: Wave 4 confirmed arbitrary origin reflection. Null-origin via sandboxed iframe is standard technique — no pre-test needed, execute directly in Wave 5.

chains.name: CORS → Auth → SSRF → Azure IMDS Token
chains.wave_5_action: EXECUTE ssrf-exploit after chain_002 provides session. Probe all 11 confirmed SSRF endpoints.

steps.description: Obtain session via chain_002 CORS null-origin exploit
Probe SSRF endpoints with Azure IMDS URL using authenticated session
steps.method: GET with auth session and Metadata: true header
steps.expected: IMDS instance metadata in response body

steps.description: Retrieve managed identity OAuth2 token from IMDS
steps.expected: access_token field in JSON response — Azure resource plane pivot

steps.description: Use managed identity token to enumerate Azure resources (Key Vault, Storage, etc.)
steps.expected: Azure resource list, potential key vault secrets exfiltration

chains.name: OIDC Nonce Absence — ID Token Replay
chains.wave_5_action: SECONDARY — requires attacker-controlled IdP or separate tenant app with nonce-less token. Harder to execute than chain_002. auth-exploit agent should note but focus on CORS PoC.

steps.description: Obtain valid Azure AD ID token from any app in same tenant (e.g., via phishing or another compromised app)
steps.expected: Valid id_token JWT signed by Azure AD

steps.description: Replay id_token to /api/auth/callback/azure-ad without nonce validation
steps.method: POST with replayed id_token and matching state
steps.expected: NextAuth accepts token, creates session without nonce check

supporting_findings.complexity: high — requires external Azure AD token or attacker-controlled IdP
